value.syntax: # [doc = " User-provided routing configuration."] # [derive (Debug , Default , Clone)] pub struct RoutingConfig { # [doc = " `--redirect` target: capture stdout and stderr merged in raw form."] pub redirect : Option < PathBuf > , # [doc = " `--redirect-output` target: capture stdout only."] pub redirect_output : Option < PathBuf > , # [doc = " `--redirect-error` target: capture stderr only."] pub redirect_error : Option < PathBuf > , # [doc = " `--redirect-prefixed` target: capture both streams with prefixes."] pub redirect_prefixed : Option < PathBuf > , # [doc = " Emit notifications when log files are written."] pub notify_on_write : bool , # [doc = " Retained output-contract control; never selects observation emission."] pub debug : bool , }
